identity: Placeholder: project name and short description (e.g., 'Scholars - AI-powered research library frontend').
tech_stack: Placeholder: primary languages, frameworks, libraries, and tooling versions used by the project.
architectural_constraints: Placeholder: architectural patterns, module boundaries, layering rules, and integration points the project must respect.
dev_test_commands: Placeholder: commands for local development, linting, type-checking, testing, and building (e.g., 'npm test', 'node tests/validate.js')
production_safety_boundaries: Placeholder: deployment restrictions, production access rules, environment-specific safety constraints, and rollback procedures.
approved_file_modification_scope: Placeholder: directories and file patterns the agent is authorized to modify within this project context.
existing_skills: Placeholder: skills already installed or available to the project (OpenCode skills directory, custom tools, templates).
reporting_destination: Placeholder: where execution reports are stored for this project (e.g., 'reports/' or a dedicated reporting branch/repo).
human_approval_requirements: Placeholder: operations requiring explicit human approval before execution (e.g., production changes, PR merges, credential rotation, repository writes).
